ayahs.1: Jin logon ne kufr kiya aur Allah ki raah se roka Allah ne un ke aamaal barbaad kar diye.
ayahs.2: Aur jo log imaan laaye aur achhe kaam kiye aur is par bhi imaan laaye jo Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam) par utaari gayi hai aur darasal un ke Rabb ki taraf se sachcha (deen) bhi wohi hai, Allah ne un ke gunaah door kar diye aur un ke haal ki islaah kar di.
ayahs.3: Yeh is liye ke kaafiron ne baatil ki pairwi ki aur mominon ne is deen-e-haq ki ittibaa ki jo un ke Allah ki taraf se hai, Allah Taala logon ko un ke ahwaal isi tarah bataata hai.
ayahs.4: To jab kaafiron se tumhari muthbher ho to gardanon par waar maaro. Jab un ko achhi tarah kuchal daalo to ab khoob mazboot qaid-o-band se giraftaar karo, (phir ikhtiyaar hai) ke khwah ehsaan rakh kar chhod do ya fidya le kar taa-waqteke ladaai apne hathiyaar rakh de. Yehi hukm hai aur Allah agar chahta to (khud) hi un se badla le leta, lekin (is ka mansha yeh hai) ke tum mein se ek ka imtihaan doosre ke zariye se le le, jo log Allah ki raah mein shaheed kar diye jaate hain Allah un ke aamaal hargiz zaaya na karega.
ayahs.5: Unhein raah dikhaayega aur un ke haalaat ki islaah kar dega.
ayahs.6: Aur unhein is jannat mein le jaayega jis se unhein shanaasa kar diya hai.
ayahs.7: Ae imaan walo! Agar tum Allah (ke deen) ki madad karoge to woh tumhari madad karega aur tumhein saabit-qadam rakhega.
ayahs.8: Aur jo log kaafir hue unhein halaaki ho Allah un ke aamaal ghaarat kar dega.
ayahs.9: Yeh is liye ke woh Allah ki naazil-karda cheez se naakhush hue, pas Allah Taala ne (bhi) un ke aamaal zaaya kar diye.
ayahs.10: Kya un logon ne zameen mein chal phir kar is ka muaaina nahin kiya ke un se pehle ke logon ka nateeja kya hua? Allah ne unhein halaak kar diya aur kaafiron ke liye isi tarah ki sazaayen hain.
ayahs.11: Woh is liye ke imaan walon ka kaarsaaz khud Allah Taala hai aur is liye ke kaafiron ka koi kaarsaaz nahin.
ayahs.12: Jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye unhein Allah Taala aise baaghon mein daakhil karega jin ke neeche nehrein jaari hain aur jo log kaafir hue woh (dunya hi ka) faida utha rahe hain aur misl-e-chaupaayon ke kha rahe hain, un ka (asal) thikaana jahannam hai.
ayahs.13: Hum ne kitni bastiyon ko jo taaqat mein teri is basti se ziyaada thin jis se tujhe nikaala hum ne unhein halaak kar diya hai, jin ka madadgaar koi na utha.
ayahs.14: Kya pas woh shakhs jo apne Parwardigaar ki taraf se daleel par ho is shakhs jaisa ho sakta hai? Jis ke liye is ka bura kaam muzayyan kar diya gaya ho aur woh apni nafsaani khwahishon ka pairav ho?
ayahs.15: Is jannat ki sifat jis ka parhezgaaron se waada kiya gaya hai, yeh hai ke is mein paani ki nehrein hain jo badboo karne wala nahin, aur doodh ki nehrein hain jin ka maza nahin badla aur sharaab ki nehrein hain jin mein peene walon ke liye badi lazzat hai aur nehrein hain shehad ki jo bahut saaf hain aur un ke liye wahan har qism ke meway hain aur un ke Rabb ki taraf se maghfirat hai, kya yeh misl is ke hain jo hamesha aag mein rehne wala hai? Aur jinhein garam khaulta hua paani pilaaya jaayega jo un ki aanton ko tukde tukde kar dega.
ayahs.16: Aur un mein baaz (aise bhi hain ke) teri taraf kaan lagaate hain. Yahan tak ke jab tere paas se jaate hain to Ahl-e-Ilm se (bawajh kund-zehni wa-laaparwaahi ke) poochhte hain ke is ne abhi kya kaha tha? Yehi log hain jin ke dilon par Allah ne mohar kar di hai aur woh apni khwahishon ki pairwi karte hain.
ayahs.17: Aur jo log hidayat-yaafta hain Allah ne unhein hidayat mein aur badha diya hai aur unhein un ki parhezgaari ata farmaayi hai.
ayahs.18: To kya yeh qayamat ka intizaar kar rahe hain ke woh un ke paas achaanak aa jaaye yaqeenan is ki alaamaten to aa chuki hain, phir jabke un ke paas qayamat aa jaaye unhein naseehat karna kahan hoga?
ayahs.19: So (ae Nabi!) Aap yaqeen kar len ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin aur apne gunaahon ki bakhshish maanga karein aur momin mardon aur momin auraton ke haq mein bhi, Allah tum logon ki aamad-o-raft ki aur rehne sehne ki jagah ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.20: Aur jo log imaan laaye woh kehte hain koi soorat kyun naazil nahin ki gayi? Phir jab koi saaf matlab wali soorat naazil ki jaati hai aur is mein qitaal ka zikr kiya jaata hai to Aap dekhte hain ke jin logon ke dilon mein beemaari hai woh Aap ki taraf is tarah dekhte hain jaise is shakhs ki nazar hoti hai jis par maut ki behoshi taari ho, pas bahut behtar tha un ke liye.
ayahs.21: Faramaan ka baja laana aur achhi baat ka kehna. Phir jab kaam muqarrar ho jaaye, to Allah ke saath sachche rahein to un ke liye behtari hai.
ayahs.22: Aur tum se yeh bhi baeed nahin ke agar tum ko hukoomat mil jaaye to tum zameen mein fasaad barpa kar do aur rishte naate tod daalo.
ayahs.23: Yehi woh log hain jin par Allah ki phitkaar hai aur jin ki samaat aur aankhon ki roshni chheen li hai.
ayahs.24: Kya yeh Quran mein ghaur-o-fikr nahin karte? Ya un ke dilon par taale lag gaye hain.
ayahs.25: Jo log apni peeth ke bal ulte phir gaye is ke baad un ke liye hidayat waazeh ho chuki yaqeenan shaitaan ne un ke liye (un ke fael ko) muzayyan kar diya hai aur unhein dheel de rakhi hai.
ayahs.26: Yeh is liye ke unhon ne un logon se jinhon ne Allah ki naazil-karda wahi ko bura samjha yeh kaha ke hum bhi anqareeb baaz kaamon mein tumhara kaha maanenge, aur Allah un ki posheeda baatein khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.27: Pas un ki kaisi (durgat) hogi jabke farishte un ki rooh qabz karte hue un ke chehron aur un ki sareenon par maarenge.
ayahs.28: Yeh is bina par ke yeh woh raah chale jis se unhon ne Allah ko naaraaz kar diya aur unhon ne is ki raza-mandi ko bura jaana, to Allah ne un ke aamaal akaarat kar diye.
ayahs.29: Kya un logon ne jin ke dilon mein beemaari hai yeh samajh rakha hai ke Allah un ke keenon ko zaahir na karega.
ayahs.30: Aur agar hum chahte to un sab ko tujhe dikha dete pas tu unhein un ke chehre se hi pehchaan leta, aur yaqeenan tu unhein un ki baat ke dhab se pehchaan lega, tumhare sab kaam Allah ko maloom hain.
ayahs.31: Yaqeenan hum tumhara imtihaan karenge taake tum mein se jihaad karne walon aur sabr karne walon ko zaahir kar den aur hum tumhari haalat ki bhi jaanch kar len.
ayahs.32: Yaqeenan jin logon ne kufr kiya aur Allah ki raah se logon ko roka aur Rasool ki mukhaalifat ki is ke baad ke un ke liye hidayat zaahir ho chuki yeh hargiz hargiz Allah ka kuchh nuqsaan na kar sakenge. Anqareeb un ke aamaal woh ghaarat kar dega.
ayahs.33: Ae imaan walo! Allah ki itaa'at karo aur Rasool ka kaha maano aur apne aamaal ko ghaarat na karo.
ayahs.34: Jin logon ne kufr kiya aur Allah ki raah se auron ko roka phir kufr ki haalat mein hi mar gaye (yaqeen kar lo) ke Allah unhein hargiz na bakhshega.
ayahs.35: Pas tum boode ban kar sulah ki darkhwaast par na utar aao jabke tum hi buland-o-ghaalib rahoge aur Allah tumhare saath hai, naamumkin hai ke woh tumhare aamaal zaaya kar de.
ayahs.36: Waaqai zindagaani-e-dunya to sirf khel kood hai aur agar tum imaan le aaoge aur taqwa ikhtiyaar karoge to Allah tumhein tumhare ajr dega aur woh tum se tumhare maal nahin maangta.
ayahs.37: Agar woh tum se tumhara maal maange aur zor de kar maange to tum is se bukheeli karne lagoge aur woh tumhare keene zaahir kar dega.
ayahs.38: Khabardaar! Tum woh log ho ke Allah ki raah mein kharch karne ke liye bulaaye jaate ho, to tum mein se baaz bukheeli karne lagte hain aur jo bukhl karta hai woh to darasal apni jaan se bukheeli karta hai. Allah Taala ghani hai aur tum faqeer (aur mohtaaj) ho aur agar tum roogardaan ho jaao to woh tumhare badle tumhare siwa aur logon ko laayega jo phir tum jaise na honge.
